answer: One defence is Notable immigration officer licence with immigration officers attestation: a licence officers renew after border audits, and the voyage of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the lantern is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the nectar of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
